text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 2) Notification 2012
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 3rd August 2012 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2012” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the Singapore Arms. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The design draws inspiration from the National Day Parade (NDP) 2012 theme “Loving Singapore, Our Home”. At the centre of the coin is a group of children from the 4 main ethnic backgrounds coming together to rejoice in the nation’s 47th birthday at The Float @ Marina Bay, the venue for this year’s National Day celebrations. The city skyline and the grandstand on the right in the background portray the venue for the celebrations. The official NDP 2012 logo is at the upper-right of the coin, while the words “47 Years of Independence” are at the upper-left of the coin. The denomination of the coin is at the lower-centre of the coin.
